name: sandbox
description: Reserve a disposable published Studio place for one task

acquire.description: Reserve a configured slot and begin preparing an isolated project

prepare.description: Continue preparation; return when ready or when another bounded step is needed

refresh.description: Load the worktree's current projection into the owned stopped sandbox

run.description: Run a targeted Renium test/capture command in the owned sandbox

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Specific runtime question; required when starting Play

release.description: Close the owned Studio, erase test data and reset the slot; resumable on interruption

status.description: Read local slot ownership and progress without opening Studio
